subject: Meridian: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist & service-account handoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Meridian - initial handoff: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist

Hi Monica / Jonas,

Following the contract signature, Meridian (contact: Olivia Jackson) asked us to kick off the implementation for SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and network allowlisting. They want a one-week staging window, then a go-live the week of Nov 29. Key asks captured in the sales doc:

- SAML IdP metadata exchange (Okta customer-managed)
- SCIM provisioning: user + team mapping, external_id sync, group sync cadence
- IP allowlist for two VPN egress ranges (they supplied ranges)
- A dedicated service account for their CI jobs and a read-only monitoring service account
- Org policy: enforce 2FA on Redwood console, disable public user invites

Attachments: I attached the mapping CSV they uploaded and the signed SOW.

Immediate asks for implementation:
1) Monica: can you validate the SCIM mapping columns in the attached CSV and confirm any custom attributes we need?
2) Jonas: please review the IP allowlist policy & service account requirements from a security standpoint; flag anything that requires enterprise exceptions.
3) I'll schedule the kickoff call with Meridian for Tuesday (11/16) at 10am PT once we confirm internal availability.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Meridian - initial handoff: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist

Thanks Karthik — quick read of the CSV shows:

- Columns present: email, givenName, familyName, externalId, title, managerEmail, department, groups. Good baseline.
- Missing from their example: phone_number and two custom flags we often use (employee_type, provisioning_scope). We should ask Meridian if they need those synced.
- For group sync: confirm whether Meridian expects group membership to map to Redwood "teams" (they mentioned "product-*" groups). If so, we need a clear prefix rule.

Implementation notes / risks:
- If externalId is not stable (they're using email now), provisioning will create duplicates if emails change; recommend external_id populated with HR ID if possible.
- SCIM rate limits: for large initial syncs we'll use batch provisioning mode — I can prepare a script to throttle to our recommended 200 req/min.

Action items for them before kickoff:
- Provide Okta IdP metadata (XML) and confirm ACS/Entity IDs.
- Confirm preferred SCIM unique id (external_id vs email).
- Provide the final list of groups to map and current user count by group.

I'll draft a short checklist to share on the kickoff.

—Monica
Senior Implementation Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Jackson <olivia.jackson@meridianfinance.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Zhao <tim.zhao@meridianfinance.com>, Product Ops <ops@meridianfinance.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Meridian - initial handoff: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist

Hi Karthik — thanks for the notes and Monica for the quick review. Tim and I chatted and attached a cleaned CSV (meridian_scim_mappings_20261112.csv) and a doc that lists our two egress ranges. Answers inline: 

- We'll use Okta and can export metadata by EOD tomorrow.
- We can populate employee_id (HR ID) as external_id — we'll include that in the CSV.
- Groups: yes, map product-* groups to Redwood teams and prefix with "prod-" on your side.
- Expected user count for initial sync: 3,400 users; active groups ~120.

Service account needs:
- ci-service@meridianfinance.com (full write for provisioning actions)
- monitor-readonly@meridianfinance.com (read-only tokens for health checks)

We'll be available for Tue 11/16 10am PT for kickoff. Attached: meridian_scim_mappings_20261112.csv and service-account-namespaces.xlsx

Regards,
Olivia Jackson
Head of IT Operations
Meridian Financial

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Jackson <olivia.jackson@meridianfinance.com>, Tim Zhao <tim.zhao@meridianfinance.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800

Great — thanks Olivia, that helps a lot. Confirmed for the kickoff at 10am PT (I'll send calendar invite).

Quick notes before the call:
- Monica will lead SCIM mapping decisions; please have the final CSV and Okta metadata ready.
- Jonas: you'll confirm ip ranges and provide the requiredd firewall entries; note that we prefer CIDR ranges at the subnet level.
- I'll prepare the mutual action plan with milestones: staging start, staged validation, cutover rehearsal, go-live.

Attachments for kickoff: redwood_sso_quickstart.pdf (we'll walk this doc), and a draft action plan I'll post to the ticket during the call.

See you at 10.
Karthik

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Jackson <olivia.jackson@meridianfinance.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2026 16:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Meridian - initial handoff: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist

Following the kick — couple follow-ups for their security team: 

- IP allowlist: I reviewed their egress ranges in the sheet. We'll require two firewall entries scoped to these CIDRs plus a short list of support IPs used by Redwood for health checks. Please add support@meridianfinance.com to the exception notification list in case we need emergency access.
- Service accounts: we will create two scoped API keys. For the ci-service account, we recommend rotating keys every 30 days and storing secrets in their KMS. For monitor-readonly, we'll issue a read-only token with a scoped TTL of 90 days.
- Org policies: enforce 2FA on root/admin accounts and restrict console invites to approved HR roles only; we'll provide an RBAC template.

Next steps (I'll own these):
1) Post the final firewall entries to the ticket (done by EOD tomorrow).
2) Send RBAC template and key rotation steps.
3) Schedule a short pre-cutover test for Nov 26.

If Meridian's security team wants an architecture diagram, Monica and I can do a 20-minute walkthrough next week.

Jonas
Security Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference
